messages.author: 89be449d770b3cc2
messages.subject: Plot standardized residual matrix
parts:
Hi,

Can somebody please tell me how I can plot (scatterplot) the residual matrixes from SEM using the 'group' function?
This is my syntax:

### SEM
model <- '
extsoc =~ JOBMOTIVATIE_extsoc1 + JOBMOTIVATIE_extsoc2 + JOBMOTIVATIE_extsoc3
extmat =~ JOBMOTIVATIE_extmat1 + JOBMOTIVATIE_extmat2 + JOBMOTIVATIE_extmat3
introj =~ JOBMOTIVATIE_introj1 + JOBMOTIVATIE_introj2 + JOBMOTIVATIE_introj3 + JOBMOTIVATIE_introj4
ident =~ JOBMOTIVATIE_ident1 + JOBMOTIVATIE_ident2 + JOBMOTIVATIE_ident3
intrin =~ JOBMOTIVATIE_intrin1 + JOBMOTIVATIE_intrin2 + JOBMOTIVATIE_intrin3

MEAN_Smartconsumer ~ extsoc
MEAN_Smartconsumer ~ extmat
MEAN_Smartconsumer ~ introj
MEAN_Smartconsumer ~ ident
MEAN_Smartconsumer ~ intrin

MEAN_BEINGABLETO ~ extsoc
MEAN_BEINGABLETO ~ extmat
MEAN_BEINGABLETO ~ introj
MEAN_BEINGABLETO ~ ident
MEAN_BEINGABLETO ~ intrin

MEAN_VALUING ~ extsoc
MEAN_VALUING ~ extmat
MEAN_VALUING ~ introj
MEAN_VALUING ~ ident
MEAN_VALUING ~ intrin

MEAN_DOINGRESEARCH ~ extsoc
MEAN_DOINGRESEARCH ~ extmat
MEAN_DOINGRESEARCH ~ introj
MEAN_DOINGRESEARCH ~ ident
MEAN_DOINGRESEARCH ~ intrin


JOBMOTIVATIE_introj1 ~~ JOBMOTIVATIE_introj4
JOBMOTIVATIE_introj3 ~~ JOBMOTIVATIE_introj4
JOBMOTIVATIE_extsoc2 ~~ JOBMOTIVATIE_extsoc3

'
fit <- sem(model, data=dat_SEM, group="fitK3.cluster")
summary(fit, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE)
fitted(fit)
coef(fit)
resid(fit)

Thank you for your help!

messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: Plot standardized residual matrix
parts:
Lies,
  I think that your question is hard to answer because it is not clear what you have in mind.  What would you like to plot on the x and y axes?

  Remember that the usual SEM residuals are residuals of the sufficient statistics (covariances, means), they are not individual residuals.  So, the resid method for lavaan objects will not give you and NxP matrix of residuals but rather a PxP matrix where N is the number of observations and P is the number of variables.

  Personally, I like to stem-and-leaf plot the unique off-diagonal residuals from the covariance matrix.  You might consider a scatterplot to plot these on the y axis and the observed values on the x axis.  Or, you could scatterplot standardized or normalized residuals against the raw residuals.

Keith
